The technical analysis of the stock market is a method of forecasting the direction of stock prices using historical data to identify patterns and trends. We use moving averages to smooth out price data by creating a constantly updated average price. The MACD (Moving Average Convergence Divergence) is a trend-following momentum indicator that shows the relationship between two moving averages of prices. The relative strength index (RSI) is a momentum indicator that measures the magnitude of recent price changes to evaluate overbought or over-sold conditions. Fibonacci retracement levels are areas of support or resistance based on key Fibonacci ratios. Bollinger Bands are volatility indicators that help determine whether the price is overbought or over-sold. In this instance, we analyze the Moving Averages, MACD, Relative Strength Index, Fibonacci Retracement, and Bollinger Bands for stock CC.D.C.USS.IP. Overall, the technical analysis suggests that the stock is in a downward trend and is currently trading at a neutral level.
